answer: Give each newcomer exactly one unclaimed public ticket and require a unique method cipher describing how it will finish that ticket. Tickets live in a rotating garden of unpaid work; the result is accepted only after a vine of three stewards who have never reviewed one another attests that the described method was actually executed, not pasted, and that the cipher has never appeared on any other ticket. A sybil factory cannot mass-register aliases because each garden plot and each steward endorsement is single-use, and colliding ciphers are rejected at admission.
